verdict.rationale: Sentry's own docs say supported AI libraries are instrumented automatically when installed. As of JS SDK 11.0.0, the most popular AI SDKs and frameworks are auto-instrumented out of the box. Per-integration options such as include_prompts and recordInputs/recordOutputs confirm these are first-party integrations. missing for 10: an explicit list naming LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these integrations work.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK

citations.quote: Supported AI libraries are instrumented automatically when their packages are installed.
As of SDK version `11.0.0`, Sentry auto-instruments the most popular AI SDKs and frameworks out of the box — you don't need to add their integrations yourself.
You can also set `recordInputs` / `recordOutputs` on a specific AI integration.
